name: Tsubata Kazumi
source:
She runs the restaurant as the hostess of a small restaurant called “Anzu”. She is widow, her husband died of an illness 10 years ago. She has raised her daughter by herself. 

She has a calm, easy-going personality with a sunny disposition and a bit of a natural streak. After her husband's death, she has not had any flirtatious conversations, but when she has sex with the protagonist for the first time in a long time, her dormant woman urges are awakened.

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/kazumi1/kazumi1.html]official site[/url]]
